description: This file defines multiple Orleans grain classes related to storage facets, including interfaces and implementations for storage grains with different factory and configuration patterns.

classes.name: StorageFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFacetGrain, providing storage name and extended info retrieval.

classes.name: StorageFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageFactoryGrain, creating storage instances via a named factory.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFactoryGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFactoryGrain, creating storage instances via a default factory.

classes.name: StorageDefaultFacetGrain
classes.description: Implements IStorageDefaultFacetGrain, with storage instances configured with attributes.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the names of the storage instances.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns extended information about the storage instances.
